title: 12 AWG bare solid copper grounding conductor of NM-B cable

sources.citation: A US maker's public NM-B product sheet (rev. 03/2019, read; it carries no ampacity column), paraphrased: NM-B carries an uninsulated copper equipment grounding conductor, wrapped in fire-retardant paper and laid between or beside the insulated conductors; it is the circuit conductors' size at 14 to 10 AWG and 10 AWG in 8/3 and 6/3. A bare EGC is permitted by NFPA 70-2023 Art. 250.119 (by number). The paper wrap is not modelled (no insulation row, colour bare).
The sheet read makes every conductor of 12 AWG NM-B solid (soft copper per ASTM B3, by number), the grounding conductor included: one strand.

Soft (annealed) uncoated copper, as the NM-B sheet states for the conductors (solid per ASTM B3; the standards cited by number, not read). Its resistivity, temperature coefficient and density are the pinned materials row copperAnnealed (100 % IACS, NBS Handbook 100). The area comes from the AWG definition (AWG_GAUGES), never from a conductor table.
Physics definition: a solid conductor has no strand lay, so its lay factor is 1 and its resistance is that of its nominal area (ADR 0018 §2).
